{{Quote|Many, many years ago...when I was a much younger man...my daughter, Felicia, was kidnapped. She was the most precious thing in the galaxy to me, and yet she was snatched away.|Wernell Covington, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:V" />}}
'''Wernell Covington''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've spared no expense in tracking down the kidnappers...one by one. And I have personally struck the killing blow each time one was found. All of the original kidnappers are now dead, except for two. Those last two have evaded me and now my age and dwindling wealth have forced me to turn to someone else for assistance.|Wernell Covington, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:V" />}}
Wernell Covington was a wealthy land owner who lived on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], a moon of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:V" /> Sometime during the last decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]],<ref name="TQC">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68410&month=082009|text=Friday Feature &ndash; The Quest Continues}}</ref> his beloved daughter [[Felicia]] was kidnapped. Despite attempts to pay the ransom and the best efforts of law enforcement officers, Felicia was killed by the kidnappers. She was jettisoned into space from the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on which she was being held. Covington was traumatized by the awful fate of his daughter and became committed to the task of avenging her [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="SWG:V" /> During almost three decades,<ref name="TQC" /> Wernell Covington tracked all the murderers one by one and even personally killed a number of the kidnappers.<ref name="SWG:V" />

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Covington's age and diminishing wealth forced him to turn to someone else to eliminate the remaining two perpetrators. To that end, he hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate the whereabouts of the remaining kidnappers.<ref name="SWG:V" /> The spacer was recommended to him by an associate, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Varias]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:TrR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Traveling to Rori|Corellia}}</ref> With the help of [[Horace Korr]], a retired [[Corellia Times]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]], the spacer was able to identify the two kidnappers: [[Jurgen Nath]] and [[Vladlun Travan]]. An associate of Covington in the [[Narmle Militia]] was later able to provide the last known locations of the criminals. The spacer eventually tracked the murderers to [[Jurgen Nath's Hideout|their]] [[Vladlun Travan's Hideout|bunkers]]. The spacer succeeded in killing them, allowing Covington to live out his days in peace.<ref name="SWG:V" />

Wernell Covington later recommended the spacer to work for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Orden Tarc|Tarc]], a [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RNSF]] officer on Rori.<ref name="SWG:LOT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Lieutenant Orden Tarc|Rori}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Wernell Covington was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:V" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Wernell Covington was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
